resources.string: Large card only. Align the three areas independently. Separate track and artist fields stay on separate lines; if the app combines them, select its separator without guessing. All text wraps when too wide and fits or truncates when too tall. Lyrics/main title use the phone title field; no extra track title is invented.

Park first. Replays the key that triggered this rule as one Android key press/release using existing ADB approval. Test with the physical key, not the Test button. Original behaviour is not guaranteed: the car may reject synthetic keys or route them to the focused app. No automatic approval, retries or CarPlay fallback. Power, call, system-navigation and typing keys are excluded. Continue?
Music and map windows: position, size, artwork and text. Adjust while parked.
Cover corner radius (% of short edge)

Artwork: 60–480 dp side length, limited by the window with room kept for text. Title and artist fonts: 12–72 sp, adjusted independently. Changes apply immediately; small windows may show fewer lines or smaller text. Instrument map labels are not affected.

Sets the video canvas requested from iPhone, not the window size. Fixed resolutions are independent of the window. Save, then reconnect CarPlay manually. If hardware checks fail, a lower resolution is used; the final fallback follows window size in Fit mode or panel aspect in Panel crop mode. Higher resolution does not guarantee larger labels or more route coverage. If video is black or stutters, lower the resolution and reconnect.

First fits the video to a %1$d × %2$d instrument panel, then shows only the chosen region without shrinking it again. Changing window size changes the visible area, not the label scale. Viewport centre selects the region; window X/Y only places the window. Four-edge trimming only hides source edges in this mode; Fit/Fill and Crop in place are not used. Fixed-canvas display changes apply immediately; switching modes with Automatic selected requires manual reconnect. iPhone safe-area settings remain separate and require reconnect. No automatic route recognition; avoid cutting off the vehicle marker, destination or guidance.
This car uses %1$d ambient colors. The color choices have been updated; check your colors, then tap Save again.

While parked, save one decoded frame from the visible custom instrument map window, before DiPlay cropping, scaling and edge blending. Uses the decoded content dimensions, not the window size. The iPhone map layout and decoder color conversion remain. May contain your location and route. Saved locally in Downloads/DiPlay when available, otherwise app storage; nothing is sent automatically. Keep the map visible and connected until capture completes.
Saved in app storage. Use Share to copy the PNG out before uninstalling the app.
Map frame operation failed (%1$s). Make sure the custom map window is visible and showing video, then retry. If copying repeatedly fails, this firmware may not support it.
A map frame is already being captured or saved. Please wait.

Sends a real two-finger gesture to the main CarPlay screen, not the instrument map. Centre coordinates refer to the full CarPlay canvas; split-screen or app layout changes may require adjustment. Test while parked. Stop, disconnection or manual touch cancels the remaining sequence. Whether zoom works depends on the current app.

Mini keeps artwork beside text. Large card places artwork above text; left/right artwork settings apply only to Mini. Each mode remembers its own position and size; changes apply immediately without reconnecting. Adjust while parked and keep speed, gear and warnings visible.
Range 1.1–8.0; default 4.0 keeps the previous gesture. Larger values change finger spacing more, not necessarily the app zoom ratio. Test while parked, starting with 2.0 for a gentler gesture.

On: remove only the selected source edges, without recentering or resizing the rest. Off: refit and centre the cropped picture, which may move the opposite edge. Applies immediately. In fill mode, source edges already outside the window may hide small crop changes.

Crop percentages refer to the original video. Cropping applies before edge blending and does not change the map camera. Use Crop in place to keep the other edges fixed, or turn it off to enlarge the remaining picture. Avoid cutting off guidance.

Fixed canvases are independent of window size. Save, then reconnect CarPlay manually to apply. Higher resolution increases decoding load and does not guarantee more map coverage. If hardware checks fail, a smaller canvas or window size is used. If video is black or stutters, choose Follow window size and reconnect. Four-edge cropping applies immediately to the video, before edge blending; no route recognition is performed.

Only for config6 candidates. First turn off DiPlay lighting control and the car\'s dynamic and music rhythm modes. Writes the same color code above 31 once per area: front, rear, then all, for 8 seconds each (24 seconds total), then restores all original colors, brightness and area. Control stays off.

Confirm that the car is safely parked; DiPlay does not read the gear position. First turn off DiPlay lighting control. In the car\'s lighting settings, turn off dynamic and music rhythm modes and choose a fixed color. Only config6 candidates can be tested; if reading the original state fails, nothing is written. DiPlay writes the same color code above 31 once to areas 1 (front), 2 (rear), then 3 (all), holding each for 8 seconds (24 seconds total), then restores and reads back all original colors, brightness and area. Within 5 minutes of completion, confirm that all three area operations and restoration looked correct. 127-color control is permitted only after that confirmation is saved successfully on this device; lighting control is never enabled automatically. Start verification?
Verifying: front, rear, then all areas, 8 seconds each (24 seconds total), then restoring the original state…
Did front, rear, then all areas each show the test color (%1$s) for 8 seconds, and did all original colors, brightness and area return correctly at the end?
Display and restoration confirmed. 127-color control remains blocked until the verification result is saved successfully.
Recorded: color not seen. Export the diagnostic report.
Recorded: not sure. You can run the test once more.

Writes, read-back and restoration succeeded. Awaiting your confirmation of the three area operations and final restoration within 5 minutes; 127-color control is not yet permitted. Lighting control stays off.
Restore not confirmed! Restore the original colors, brightness and area in the car\'s lighting settings (raw state %1$s), then export the diagnostic report.
First turn off DiPlay ambient control. If verification or saving is already running, wait for it to finish, then retry while parked.
This configuration is not a config6 candidate, or its current state does not support verification. Nothing was written.
Test failed (%1$s). The original state was restored. Export the diagnostic report.
Saving verification results on this device…
127-color verification complete. Return to configuration to enable control manually; lighting control will not turn on automatically.
Verification confirmation was not saved or has expired. 127-color control remains blocked. Park and verify again.
127-color configuration identified but not yet verified. First turn off control, run parked compatibility verification, and confirm the color changes and restoration before enabling control.
Background opacity changes only the panel background, not the whole window or video. A system window alpha of 0.8 can still let underlying content show through.

Compare Presentation and Overlay at the same position while parked. Overlay needs existing permission. Both stop after 5 seconds. App alpha is not the system-composited alpha; collect the ADB window dump too.

Park safely before starting. Do not enter sensitive information. Settings will hide and CarPlay will appear; taps will actually operate the phone. Only single-finger taps are recorded, not drags, multi-touch gestures or text. Stop recording to return to this draft automatically. Confirm, save and enable it separately; confirmation does not enable it. Record again if the phone app, resolution or layout changes, as playback may tap the wrong place.
Sets the area of the map window available to the route and vehicle marker. The default margin is 8% on each side. Changes require reconnecting CarPlay; the current connection will not be interrupted.

Crops the chosen edges of the map video, then fits the rest while preserving its aspect ratio. Edge blending fades the cropped picture. Takes effect immediately without changing map zoom or route overview mode. Default: 0. Avoid cropping navigation information.
Window background and text follow the head unit day/night mode. Opacity stays unchanged.

Connected to the vehicle. Front color code: %1$d; rear: %2$d. This color encoding and restoration of the original vehicle state have not been verified. Control has not been enabled, and no lighting commands have been sent.
At brightness 0, the lights stay at minimum brightness and do not follow the music. Raise the brightness manually to see the music response.
Old window action (disabled; choose an instrument window)

Control the instrument music/lyrics/cover window and map window separately. Enable the desired custom instrument panels first; the map stream requires a CarPlay reconnection after enabling it. Show/hide changes only visibility for this connection, without changing settings, reconnecting or affecting the main CarPlay window. A new connection starts with both enabled panels visible.
Up to 400 ms between clicks. When a higher click count is assigned, execution waits for confirmation. Only the matching count runs; lower-count actions are not also executed.

Only one shortcut can be saved for each trigger. The same key can have separate single, double, triple and quadruple click assignments; the same key and click count cannot be duplicated, including disabled rules. The CarPlay connection event is still limited to one shortcut.

This shortcut may open an iPhone app, start music or control CarPlay. Park before testing. Connection triggers run automatically on new sessions. Stop cancels remaining steps, not actions already sent. URI support and successful playback depend on the phone. Recorded taps may hit the wrong control if the iPhone app, resolution or CarPlay layout changes; record again after such changes. Continue?
Add a shortcut, then tap it in the list to edit.
Key recorded, but no playback action is assigned. Edit this step and choose an action before enabling or testing.

Press physical keys or choose actions. All key codes can be recorded; unmapped keys need an action assigned. This physical-key recording does not execute actions. Recording taps in CarPlay is separate and operates the phone. Do not enter private information.
Runs on the selected trigger after saving.
Changes stay in the draft until you tap Save.
Add actions or record keys to build a sequence.
Sequence queued; this does not confirm phone execution.

While the car\'s own audio source is playing, the iPhone can ignore media steps. DiPlay first asks the iPhone to take over the audio and waits up to 3 seconds. If music still does not start, turn on “%1$s” in Settings, or start music with a recorded tap on Play.
Unavailable: no ready CarPlay connection, in a call, recording, or another sequence is running.
Check the name, trigger, URI and actions. Up to 32 steps; each wait 0–30000 ms, total waits at most 120 seconds. Siri must be the final action.

Press a physical key within 60 seconds. Any key code delivered to DiPlay can be learned; matching uses code and scan, not device ID. Capture pauses during calls or priority voice activity. Virtual keys and keys intercepted by the system may not reach the app. Only numeric key codes are recorded, not typed text.
This input was not captured. End any call or voice activity, then try a physical key.
Recording · physical keys or action list · 60 s

Replace the draft with %1$d recorded steps? Key codes, single-finger tap positions, supported CarPlay actions and intervals are saved, not drags, multi-touch gestures or typed text. Unmapped keys need a CarPlay action before enabling or testing; arbitrary Android key injection is not available. Physical-key recording does not execute actions, but CarPlay tap recording operates the phone. Confirmation leaves the draft disabled; save and enable it separately.

Independent music and CarPlay map panels on the selected public instrument display. Either switch replaces the old projection layout without changing its saved settings. Park before adjusting; never cover speed, gear or warnings. Text, position and size update live. Enabling or disabling a panel and map resolution/content changes require reconnection for the matching video stream.

Shows the latest title or lyric line, artist and album cover throughout the CarPlay connection, even without the map. Lyrics depend on the phone app sending them as the title; a separate song name is unavailable if the title contains lyrics. No eight-second text timeout.
Uses the independent instrument video stream, not a screenshot of the main display. Map app support varies. Reconnect after enabling or changing map content or resolution.

Requires draw-over-other-apps permission. Tries an application overlay on the selected instrument display; falls back to a normal Presentation if rejected. OEM layers can still cover it. It cannot override hardware layers or guarantee topmost display. Do not cover vehicle warnings. No OEM service is stopped.
Drag panels in this preview to position them. Coordinates are percentages of the instrument display. Keep critical instruments clear.
Off: fit the entire video with letterboxing. On: fill the panel by cropping edges. This changes video fitting only, not navigation overview or follow mode.
Navigation overview / following is controlled by the iPhone map app. No verified instrument command switches these modes; video fit or zoom is not a route overview.

Run a sequence on a learned physical key or a new CarPlay connection: wait, open an app URI through requestUI, or perform CarPlay actions. Any physical key delivered to DiPlay can be recorded or used as a trigger. Unmapped keys keep their code and scan values but need a CarPlay action before enabling or testing; arbitrary Android key injection is not available. Capture pauses during calls or priority voice activity. Virtual or system-intercepted keys may not reach the app. Physical-key recording saves numeric key codes without executing actions. The separate CarPlay tap recorder operates the phone while recording single-finger taps and supported CarPlay actions. Park safely before starting. Drags, multi-touch gestures and typed text are not recorded. Stop recording to return to the draft in Settings. Accepting a recording leaves the draft disabled; save and enable it separately. Disconnecting cancels pending steps. URI support depends on the phone app; this does not fix cold-start playback.

Records NowPlaying field IDs, sizes, changes, play state, elapsed time and text samples (title, artist, album, app). These may include lyrics and listening history and will be included in exported reports. Memory only, last 300 entries, 160 characters per text, 10-minute limit. Unknown fields are not assumed to be lyrics. Starting clears earlier samples; Stop and erase removes them. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
Text capture started. Play music, then export a report before erasing samples.
Show lyrics and instrument projection diagnostics
Hide lyrics and instrument projection diagnostics

Park in P with the parking brake applied. Parking is NOT automatically verified. Disconnect CarPlay and stop existing instrument projection first. Select a known empty area using X/Y; do not cover speed, gear, warnings or indicators. Only two 24-pixel-or-smaller blocks are drawn for 5 seconds; all other pixels are transparent. No OEM mode, ADB or brightness changes. If the background turns black or anything important is covered, stop immediately. This tests visible composition, not a live map.
I am parked safely and have checked this is an empty instrument area
Blocks requested; they close after 5 seconds. Check the instrument, not this preview.
No usable public secondary display, or CarPlay / instrument projection is still active. Nothing was changed.

Only Usage Access (GET_USAGE_STATS) will be requested. Enable network ADB on this car and approve the debugging prompt if shown. Accessibility and overlay permissions will not change. Cancel stops pending work, but does not revoke access already granted.
Usage Access was not verified. Check network ADB and its approval, then retry or use the manual command.
Another ADB operation is running. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
Needed to identify foreground apps and split-screen state. Tap the status to check again. Granting access does not change your display choices or require reconnecting CarPlay.

This car has no available Usage Access settings screen. Enable access for DiPlay in system settings, or connect a computer with ADB and run:

%1$s

Then return here and tap the permission status to check again.

Rounded corners and transparent edge fading keep the centre sharp. Only changes the instrument map window; applies immediately without reconnecting. Requires instrument transparency support; turn off if edges become black. Keep the vehicle marker, route and guidance within the safe area.
Use an existing router or portable Wi-Fi. Keep the iPhone and car on the same network with Internet access.
Existing Wi-Fi · Keep both devices on the same Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on. No car hotspot is needed.

Connect the car and iPhone to the same external Wi-Fi in system settings. Enter its exact name and WPA2 password below; leave the password empty only for an open network. Use WPA2 or WPA2/WPA3 mixed mode and disable client isolation on the router. DiPlay keeps this Wi-Fi connection and creates no hotspot.
Auto chooses a channel for you. Manual channels depend on what your car supports. Changes apply to the next Wi-Fi Direct connection.
Auto · 5 GHz and Auto · 2.4 GHz keep Wi-Fi Direct in that band and let the car choose the channel. If the car cannot use that band, the connection stops with a message instead of switching band.
Built-in car hotspot · Keep the car hotspot, Bluetooth and your iPhone’s Wi-Fi on.
Open Connection setup to save your built-in car hotspot details.
Wi-Fi Direct · Keep the car’s Wi-Fi switch, Bluetooth and your iPhone’s Wi-Fi on.

Use the car’s hotspot for the smoothest wireless CarPlay. You do not need to join it manually on your iPhone; DiPlay sends the hotspot details over Bluetooth. Select 5 GHz in car settings if available.
For cars without a hotspot. Requires the car’s Wi-Fi switch on. While the car searches for Wi-Fi networks, sound and picture may stutter every few seconds.
Hotspot is off · Turn it on in car settings.
Details saved · Check that the car hotspot is on before connecting.
CarPlay authentication could not be loaded. Install the complete DiPlay build over this app. No uninstall or hotspot change is needed.
The car hotspot “%1$s” is off. Turn it on in the car settings before connecting.
DiPlay connects through the car hotspot “%1$s”. Turn it on in the car settings, then connect.
If ADB lists several devices, use adb -s <car-device-ID> shell appops set %1$s GET_USAGE_STATS allow. Find the ID with adb devices.
Safe area: %1$d x %2$d at (%3$d, %4$d) in %5$d x %6$d
The following settings are unavailable and hidden on Android 9 (API 28):\n• Wi-Fi P2P (5 GHz) — LocalOnlyHotspot is used instead.\n• HEVC software decoder — hardware decoding is used instead.
Address must start with http:// or https://. Token is optional and sent as an Authorization bearer token.
System default follows the device language.
A previous Wi-Fi Direct connection is still running. Reset it to connect.
Allow CarPlay UI outside the safe area
Allow Nearby devices and, on older Android versions, Location before resetting CarPlay Wi-Fi.
Allow Nearby devices for DiPlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
Allow Nearby devices so DiPlay can connect to your paired iPhone.
Allow precise Location for DiPlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
Allow the connection permission to continue

An independent CarPlay receiver for Android head units. Wired and wireless connections run on the head unit, with local authentication. A standard iPhone can connect without a jailbreak, Mac, dongle or sign-in.\n\nThis preview uses an experimental accessory identity. Compatibility with every iPhone and head unit is still being tested. It is not an Apple-certified product.
Automatically accept the Android USB permission prompt when an iPhone is connected via cable (requires Accessibility Service)
Automatically checks Always allow and confirms the Android USB accessory prompt for CarPlay
Automatic map enabled. Open the cluster map card or select Map theme.
Availability depends on your head unit’s startup settings.
CarPlay, at home in your car.
Changes the size of CarPlay icons and text. Applying a size reconnects CarPlay.
Channel is not valid for the selected band
Check that storage is available, or choose another save location.
Choose how to connect, follow the setup steps and save your car hotspot details.
Choose where to save your report. If the file picker is unavailable, DiPlay saves it in the app.\u0020

Only for the custom instrument map window. After a new map stream becomes visible, send these relative zoom steps once. Hiding, resuming or switching content does not add steps; manual zoom cancels pending steps. Saved changes apply on the next CarPlay connection; reconnect manually. The iPhone may still adjust zoom near turns.
Connect when the selected iPhone reconnects
After the car wakes, open DiPlay and start wireless CarPlay when the selected iPhone connects over Bluetooth. Some head units restrict background launches.
Connect your iPhone with a USB cable
Copied to the car clipboard. Run the command on your computer.
Copy these from the car’s hotspot settings. Use 5 GHz if available. Saving here does not change the car’s hotspot.
Could not reset Wi-Fi Direct. Close the other projection app and try again.
Could not start CarPlay. Return to DiPlay and check app permissions.
Drag to move, pinch to zoom

Asks the iPhone for a full-screen picture with square corners. Try it when CarPlay leaves a strip at an edge or shows the wallpaper color in its rounded corners. The safe area above is not used while this is on. Applies after Save and reconnect.
Safe area: off (square corners, full screen)
Enable the car’s Bluetooth and pair your iPhone first.
Finish setup · Save your hotspot details to use this mode.
Follow instrument theme and map card
Reconnect CarPlay to adapt stream resolution to multi-window or picture-in-picture aspect ratio. Leave disabled for instant 0ms GPU scaling.
Hide the selected system bar in DiPlay and CarPlay.
Hotspot SSID must be at most 32 UTF-8 bytes
In CarPlay, swipe down with three fingers to open DiPlay settings.
Keep Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on your iPhone. Pair with the car’s Bluetooth, then select your iPhone here. Allow Nearby devices when asked.
Keep your iPhone nearby with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on.\nAllow CarPlay if your iPhone asks.
Make DiPlay feel right for your car.
Manual mode: match the cluster theme here. The map cannot follow card visibility without Usage Access.
Nearby devices connects your iPhone. Microphone enables Siri and calls. Older Android versions also require Location for wireless setup. USB mode may ask for a local VPN connection.
Nothing is sent automatically. Protocol payloads and credentials are excluded.
On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth and pair with the car. Then return to DiPlay and choose Connect phone.

Some firmwares block third-party boot receivers. This asks the head unit, over its own ADB link, to exempt DiPlay from background limits so the boot broadcast can reach it. One-time; re-run after a firmware update.
Open this setting from your car’s Settings app.

Pair your iPhone with the car’s Bluetooth, keep Wi-Fi on, and allow CarPlay on the iPhone. Close any other phone-projection app.\n\nIf a previous projection app left its connection running, reset CarPlay Wi-Fi below and connect again. Your car’s normal internet Wi-Fi stays on.
Password must be empty when security is Open
Place CarPlay’s controls closer to the driver.
Plug your iPhone into a USB data port.\nAllow CarPlay when your iPhone asks.

Return from car settings to DiPlay, then connect. Accept the CarPlay prompt on your iPhone. A car internet plan is not required; mobile data availability depends on your phone’s network settings.
1. Connect a computer with ADB installed to the car using your existing USB or wireless debugging connection. Approve debugging on the car if asked.\n\n2. Run this command in the computer’s terminal:

1. Open car hotspot settings, turn the hotspot on and select 5 GHz if available.\n2. Copy its name and password below exactly.\n3. Leave the car hotspot on when connecting. DiPlay sends the details over Bluetooth; your iPhone joins automatically.
3. Tap Check and enable below. This enables the cluster map and automatic theme following. An active CarPlay session reconnects once. You can then disconnect the computer.

Save hotspot details and use this mode

Set up once. Your details stay saved for the next drive. Changes apply to your next connection.
The essentials for a comfortable, reliable drive.

These features can depend on vehicle firmware, ADB access, or experimental CarPlay behavior. Everyday settings are organized in the categories above.

Show phone navigation arrows, distance and street names on supported BYD displays. Vehicle compatibility varies.
Show the side map only when its card is open, and switch to the full map in Map theme. Theme and card changes keep CarPlay connected.
Shows the iPhone\'s map on the dashboard. Choose Small or Full screen navi in the dashboard\'s steering-wheel menu.
Start CarPlay automatically after device boot
Still waiting for Usage Access. Check that the command ran successfully for this car, then try again.
Tap a number to test. 14 = driver speaker on BYD.

This ends the existing Wi-Fi Direct connection, including one left behind after reinstalling. Close other projection apps first. Your car’s internet Wi-Fi stays on.

Turn the car’s Wi-Fi switch on. Allow Location / Nearby devices if requested and enable Location when Android asks. If playback stutters, try the built-in car hotspot at 5 GHz.
Usage Access lets DiPlay follow the instrument theme and map card. Only BYD cluster activity events are processed locally. This car does not provide a working permission settings page.

Use a USB data cable and the car’s USB data port. Unlock your iPhone and allow CarPlay. No hotspot setup is needed.

DiPlay draws this card on the map. Move it in 2 % steps. The iOS glass card cannot be moved on its own. Changes apply without reconnecting. The custom card stays on for straight-ahead as well as turns.
Keep the home-screen map in sync with the dashboard
On: the home-screen card mirrors the dashboard map. Off: hide the home-screen card so only the instrument cluster shows that map. This does not change CarPlay’s own main screen.

Keeps a separate car-marker position for the small navigation window (default: right of centre). Changes apply after Reconnect now. In Auto mode, switching between small and full-screen navigation reconnects CarPlay.
Default is three steps (30 %) right of centre. Adjust to wherever the small window sits on your cluster.
Usage Access granted · used if ADB cannot read the wheel navi mode.

DiPlay reads the navi mode you pick on the steering wheel. In Off and Turn on by navi the dashboard shows arrows only, so the iPhone does not send the map; in Small and Full screen navi it does, within a second or two of the switch. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.

DiPlay tells the iPhone the car\'s charge and range, so Apple Maps can warn about a low charge and suggest chargers on the way. The iPhone is told about an electric car only while DiPlay can read the battery. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
The battery cannot be read on this car, so the iPhone is not told about an electric car.
Vehicle speed cannot be read on this firmware.
Gear cannot be read on this firmware.

With Report location to iPhone on, DiPlay also sends the car\'s wheel speed and gear, so Apple Maps can keep your position moving in tunnels and car parks. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.

iOS 27: a video you send to CarPlay on the iPhone plays on the car screen while the car is in P. The player closes when you shift out of P; without ADB video stays off and the iPhone plays audio only. Plain HTTPS video (for example from Safari) plays; video protected with FairPlay, such as Apple TV+, needs a licensed receiver and does not play here. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.

The CarPlay song title and artist appear in the music card on the instrument cluster, with play and pause. This sends song text and state only, not album art. For album art, enable the cluster map and its music overlay instead. The card shows as BYD’s “Other” music source, because the dashboard does not draw CarPlay’s own source. Applies at once. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
This video can\'t play on the car screen. Protected video, such as Apple TV+, needs a licensed receiver.
Below 100%, the car\'s own screen stays visible and usable beside CarPlay. Experimental: behavior depends on the head unit.

Does the same while another app, such as WhatsApp, Telegram or Zoom, is in a voice or video call. Off by default.

Shows each main-screen CarPlay frame at the time the iPhone stamped on it plus a short delay, instead of as soon as it is decoded. The delay adjusts itself so that most frames are decoded in time; frames still not ready by their time are shown at once. Scrolling can look more even, but touches respond later. Picture adjustments do not apply. Reconnects CarPlay.

Detected %1$s for the selected video format. Uses a dedicated MTK low-latency decoder when available. Legacy OMX decoders instead try no-reorder plus low latency, then low latency alone. Automatically falls back if the decoder rejects or fails. It may reduce video delay, but some firmware can stutter or fail. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

Sends the CarPlay picture straight to the head unit\'s compositor instead of drawing it inside the DiPlay window. Can lower the delay by about one screen refresh. Picture adjustments do not apply. Reconnects CarPlay.

Asks Qualcomm video decoders to output each frame as soon as it is decoded instead of holding the next ones, and shows each decoded frame from a dedicated thread without waiting for the next one to arrive. Can lower the delay by tens of milliseconds. Turn it off if the picture shows artifacts or freezes. Applies at the next connection.

Shows a counter in the top-right corner of CarPlay: frames shown per second (green from 50, yellow from 30, red below), frames received from the iPhone per second, and the decode time. A still screen shows few frames because the iPhone sends none.
